abyssal_gaze.name: Abyssal Gaze
abyssal_gaze.description: Strike the creature you look at with wither II for 6 s and blindness plus darkness for 4 s.

abyssal_maw.name: Abyssal Maw
abyssal_maw.description: Open a 6-block vortex for 4 seconds that pulls enemies 1 block toward you each second and deals 2 damage per pulse.

abyssal_mutation.name: Abyssal Mutation
abyssal_mutation.description: For 10 seconds gain Health Boost III and Strength I, but suffer Darkness.

abyssal_tether.name: Abyssal Tether
abyssal_tether.description: Strike the looked-at target within 12 blocks, pulling it to you with Weakness for 5 s.

acorn_of_plenty.name: Acorn of Plenty
acorn_of_plenty.description: Conjure an acorn that, when eaten, grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 30 seconds.

adrenal_surge.name: Adrenal Surge
adrenal_surge.description: Haste that also gives Strength I; every hit you take while it lasts extends it.

alms.name: Alms
alms.description: Conjure bread for the party; allies who eat it gain Luck for a while.

alpine_bellow.name: Alpine Bellow
alpine_bellow.description: Allies and mounts within 8 blocks gain Speed II and Jump Boost II for 10 seconds.

ancestor_blessing.name: Ancestral Blessing
ancestor_blessing.description: An ancestor spirit heals an ally over time and gives them Spirit Resistance while it lasts.

ancestors_call.name: Ancestor's Call
ancestors_call.description: Your next arrow summons an ancestral ghost (vex) at impact that fights for 15 s.

ancestors_mercy.name: Ancestor's Mercy
ancestors_mercy.description: Create a 5-block area for 5 seconds that heals allies 1 health per second and soulburns enemies.

ancestors_shroud.name: Ancestor's Shroud
ancestors_shroud.description: For 8 seconds, the first lethal hit leaves you at 1 heart and soulburns the attacker for 5 seconds.

ancestral_sight.name: Ancestral Sight
ancestral_sight.description: For 12 s, all mobs within 24 blocks glow and you gain speed I.

ancestral_watch.name: Ancestral Watch
ancestral_watch.description: Summon 3 allied vexes that guard you for 15 seconds and soulburn enemies they hit.

arc_palm.name: Arc Palm
arc_palm.description: Strike the creature you look at; lightning arcs to up to 3 creatures within 4 blocks of it.

arrow_blood.name: Bone Arrow
arrow_blood.description: A charged arrow of bone shards that make the target bleed.

arrow_eldritch.name: Void Arrow
arrow_eldritch.description: A charged arrow of eldritch energy, pulling enemies in.

arrow_holy.name: Radiant Arrow
arrow_holy.description: A charged arrow of holy light that marks the target for 8 s: your other arrows home in on it and deal 50% more.

arrow_ice.name: Frost Arrow
arrow_ice.description: A charged arrow of ice, freezing the target.

arrow_lightning.name: Storm Arrow
arrow_lightning.description: A charged arrow of lightning, chaining to one more target.

arrow_soul.name: Soul Arrow
arrow_soul.description: A charged arrow of soul fire that soulburns and pierces up to 3 creatures.

arrow_spirit.name: Jade Arrow
arrow_spirit.description: A charged arrow of jade that splits into shards.

arrow_water.name: Tide Arrow
arrow_water.description: A charged arrow of water, soaking and slowing.

ashen_renewal.name: Ashen Renewal
ashen_renewal.description: For 12 seconds, killing a burning creature grants you Regeneration II for 4 seconds.

asp_lunge.name: Asp Lunge
asp_lunge.description: Dash 5 blocks forward; the first enemy hit gets poison II for 6 s.

avalanche_stomp.name: Avalanche Stomp
avalanche_stomp.description: Leap up to 6 blocks and land with a shockwave that freezes enemies within 4 blocks for 4 seconds.

back_alley_brawl.name: Back-Alley Brawl
back_alley_brawl.description: Hit every enemy within 3 blocks, gaining 1 absorption heart for each enemy hit.

bagua_mirror.name: Bagua Mirror
bagua_mirror.description: For 6 s, reflect 50% of damage taken back to the attacker as soulburn damage.

balanced_judgment.name: Balanced Judgment
balanced_judgment.description: Strike the creature you look at for holy damage equal to the health-percentage gap between you, minimum 4.

balanced_seal.name: Balanced Seal
balanced_seal.description: Enemies within 5 blocks lose 4 armour and allies within 5 blocks gain 4 armour for 8 seconds.

ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
ball_lightning.description: Launch a slow orb that zaps enemies within 2 blocks of its path every half second.

ballista.name: Siege Ballista
ballista.description: Place a ballista that fires heavy piercing bolts at enemies in front of it for 15 s.

bamboo_palisade.name: Bamboo Palisade
bamboo_palisade.description: Raise a bamboo wall 5 blocks wide and 3 tall in front of you for 8 s.

banner_of_the_road.name: Banner of the Road
banner_of_the_road.description: Plant a banner; for 8 seconds allies within 5 blocks regain 1 hunger per second and have Resistance I.

baptism.name: Baptism
baptism.description: Cleanse that also gives the target Regeneration and water breathing.

barrow_howl.name: Barrow Howl
barrow_howl.description: Roar in a 6-block cone, applying Weakness II and freezing creatures for 4 seconds.

barrow_thrall.name: Barrow Thrall
barrow_thrall.description: Summon a frost-armoured zombie for 30 s that explodes on death, freezing enemies within 4 blocks 3 s.

beacon_flare.name: Beacon Flare
beacon_flare.description: Throw a flare that lights a 6-block area for 6 s, giving enemies glowing and allies speed I.

bear.name: Call the Bear
bear.description: Summon a brown bear that fights beside you.

bearded_axe.name: Bearded Axe
bearded_axe.description: Hurl an axe that bounces between up to 3 creatures within 5 blocks, damaging each.

bellows_blast.name: Bellows Blast
bellows_blast.description: Blast a 6-block cone of fire that knocks enemies back 4 blocks and ignites them for 4 seconds.

belly_drum.name: Belly Drum
belly_drum.description: Drum a 5-block cone, knocking enemies back 3 blocks and giving nausea for 4 s.

binding_fu.name: Binding Fu
binding_fu.description: Throw a paper talisman; the creature hit is stunned for 3 s and takes +25% damage from your summons.

bindle_bash.name: Bindle Bash
bindle_bash.description: Throw your bindle; the creature hit is stunned for 2 s and drops a random food item.

black_ice.name: Black Ice
black_ice.description: Leave a slick of black ice: enemies on it slip, slow and drop their guard.

blaze_spirits.name: Summon Blaze Spirits
blaze_spirits.description: Summon allied blazes that shoot fire charges at your enemies.

bleeding_bone.name: Bleeding Bone
bleeding_bone.description: Throw a sharpened bone that inflicts Bleeding for 6 seconds, healing you 1 health per bleed tick.

blessed_bread.name: Blessed Bread
blessed_bread.description: Conjure 3 bread that restore 6 hunger and grant regeneration I and night vision for 30 s.

blessed_font.name: Blessed Font
blessed_font.description: A 5-block font pulses for 6 s, healing allies 2 HP every 2 s and extinguishing fire.

blink_fuse.name: Blink Fuse
blink_fuse.description: For 6 s, the first time you are hit you teleport 5 blocks away and gain Speed III 3 s.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood_frenzy.description: Each kill for 15 s heals you and extends the frenzy.

blood_scent.name: Blood Scent
blood_scent.description: Make all creatures below 50% health within 20 blocks glow for 10 seconds and gain Speed II.

blood_tithe.name: Blood Tithe
blood_tithe.description: Sacrifice 4 health to gain Strength II and 20% extra life steal for 10 seconds.

bloodied_bulwark.name: Bloodied Bulwark
bloodied_bulwark.description: For 8 seconds gain Resistance I and +1 attack damage for every 2 hearts you are missing.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Each hit you land with dual weapons gives a stack of life steal (up to 5).

bloom_lash.name: Bloom Lash
bloom_lash.description: A 5-block cone of vines roots enemies with Slowness V 3 s and heals allies 3 HP.

blubber_ration.name: Blubber Ration
blubber_ration.description: Conjure blubber that, when eaten, grants Resistance I and Water Breathing for 2 minutes.

boar_rush.name: Boar Rush
boar_rush.description: Dash 8 blocks forward, launching creatures in your path into the air.

body_outside_body.name: Body Outside of Body
body_outside_body.description: Pluck a hair and blow on it: two clones of yourself that fight with your held weapon instead of casting spells.

bog.name: Bog
bog.description: Turn the ground into a sucking bog: enemies sink, slow and take poison.

bogberry_brew.name: Bogberry Brew
bogberry_brew.description: Conjure a brew; drinking grants Regeneration I 15 s and Water Breathing 60 s.

bola.name: Bola
bola.description: Throw a bola that wraps the target: it is rooted for 3 s and can't attack for 1.5 s.

bolt_drop.name: Bolt Drop
bolt_drop.description: Leap 6 blocks; on landing, a shock ring deals 6 damage and stuns creatures within 4 blocks for 1 second.

bolt_kunai.name: Bolt Kunai
bolt_kunai.description: Throw a kunai that calls a small lightning strike on hit and makes the target glow 6 s.

bone_guard.name: Bone Bulwark
bone_guard.description: Raise armoured skeleton shieldbearers that guard you.

bone_lattice.name: Bone Lattice
bone_lattice.description: Raise a ring of bone blocks around you for 6 s; enemies touching it get wither I for 4 s.

bone_steed.name: Bone Steed
bone_steed.description: Summon a skeleton horse that never tires and does not fear the dark.

bonehound_pack.name: Bonehound Pack
bonehound_pack.description: Summon 2 skeletal wolves for 25 s whose bites apply wither I for 3 s.

borealis_veil.name: Borealis Veil
borealis_veil.description: For 10 s, attackers that hit you are struck by a small lightning bolt and frozen 2 s, once per 2 s.

borrowed_face.name: Borrowed Face
borrowed_face.description: Become invisible for 8 s; your first hit from invisibility deals +6 damage and wither for 4 s.

bottomless_ladle.name: Bottomless Ladle
bottomless_ladle.description: Strike the looked-at target, filling its lungs: drowning damage for 3 s and soulburn 4 s.

bound_shade.name: Bound Shade
bound_shade.description: Summon 2 allied vexes for 20 s whose hits make targets glow.

bounty.name: Bounty Mark
bounty.description: Mark a target; killing it gives extra loot and experience.

brackish_bile.name: Brackish Bile
brackish_bile.description: Throw a bile flask; enemies within 3 blocks get Poison II 4 s and Nausea 6 s.

bramble_shot.name: Bramble Shot
bramble_shot.description: Your next arrow roots the target with slowness VI for 3 s and makes it glow for 8 s.

brand_blood.name: Bloodbrand
brand_blood.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra blood damage and make foes bleed. One brand at a time.

brand_eldritch.name: Voidbrand
brand_eldritch.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra eldritch damage and weaken. One brand at a time.

brand_fire.name: Flamebrand
brand_fire.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra fire damage and set foes alight. One brand at a time.

brand_holy.name: Sanctified Edge
brand_holy.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra holy damage, double to the undead. One brand at a time.

brand_ice.name: Frostbrand
brand_ice.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra freezing damage and slow. One brand at a time.

brand_lightning.name: Stormbrand
brand_lightning.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra lightning damage and stagger. One brand at a time.

brand_nature.name: Thornbrand
brand_nature.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra nature damage and poison. One brand at a time.

brand_spirit.name: Jadebrand
brand_spirit.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra symmetry damage and shatter armour. One brand at a time.

brand_water.name: Tidebrand
brand_water.description: For 20 s your weapon hits deal extra water damage and soak (Wet). One brand at a time.

breakwater.name: Breakwater
breakwater.description: Release a wave ring that pushes enemies within 6 blocks back 5 blocks and gives allies Resistance I for 5 seconds.

briar_hedge.name: Briar Hedge
briar_hedge.description: Grow a 5-wide hedge of sweet berry bushes for 12 seconds that slows and pricks enemies walking through it.

brimstone_slimes.name: Brimstone Slimes
brimstone_slimes.description: Summon 3 magma cubes for 20 seconds that set creatures they touch on fire.

brine_frenzy.name: Brine Frenzy
brine_frenzy.description: For 10 seconds, each hit grants 1 heart of Absorption (max 4) while you stand in water or rain.

brine_lance.name: Brine Lance
brine_lance.description: Throw a lance of icy brine that freezes the target 3 s and applies Slowness III for 4 s.

brine_roar.name: Brine Roar
brine_roar.description: Roar in a 6-block cone, giving enemies Slowness II and Weakness I for 6 seconds.

broken_halo.name: Broken Halo
broken_halo.description: Throw a shattered halo that applies Wither 3 s to the target and heals you 2 HP.

bulwark_charge.name: Bulwark Charge
bulwark_charge.description: Dash 6 blocks forward, knocking back every enemy you pass 4 blocks and gaining Resistance II for 4 seconds.

burning_dead.name: Burning Dead
burning_dead.description: Raise burning zombies that explode into fire when they die.

burning_roots.name: Searing Roots
burning_roots.description: Roots that also set the trapped creature on fire.

burning_sheath.name: Burning Sheath
burning_sheath.description: For 8 seconds your hits ignite targets, and every third hit explodes for 4 damage within 2 blocks.

calling_card.name: Calling Card
calling_card.description: Mark a target for 20 s; if it dies, it drops double loot and you turn invisible for 5 s.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.description: Scatter caltrops behind you that slow and hurt anything that walks over them.

camel.name: Summon Camel
camel.description: Summon a camel that two players can ride.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.description: Light a campfire that heals and warms allies around it and cooks food dropped in it.

carp_leap.name: Carp Leap
carp_leap.description: Leap 6 blocks upward, gaining Slow Falling and Dolphin's Grace for 5 seconds.

carrion_beetles.name: Carrion Beetles
carrion_beetles.description: Summon 4 silverfish for 20 s whose bites apply poison I for 4 s.

carrion_cage.name: Carrion Cage
carrion_cage.description: Mark a target; when it dies it bursts, damaging enemies within 4 blocks and healing you 2 hearts per enemy hit.

cedar_cleave.name: Cedar Cleave
cedar_cleave.description: Strike the creature you look at for katana damage and root it with vines (Slowness V) for 3 seconds.

censer_step.name: Censer Step
censer_step.description: Dash 6 blocks backward, leaving an incense cloud where you stood that blinds enemies inside for 3 s.

chanko_nabe.name: Chanko Nabe
chanko_nabe.description: Conjure a hotpot that, when eaten, grants Health Boost II and Resistance I for 60 seconds.

chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Lightning
chaos_bolt.description: Black lightning from the void that also blinds.

chochin_swarm.name: Chochin Swarm
chochin_swarm.description: Summon 3 paper-lantern vexes for 20 s that burst for 3 damage in 2 blocks when they die.

cinder_husks.name: Cinder Husks
cinder_husks.description: Summon 3 fire-immune husks for 20 seconds that ignite whatever they hit.

cinder_palisade.name: Cinder Palisade
cinder_palisade.description: Raise a 5-block wall of magma blocks for 6 seconds that burns creatures touching it.

cinder_rampart.name: Cinder Rampart
cinder_rampart.description: Raise a 5-wide, 2-tall magma block wall for 8 seconds that sets enemies touching it on fire.

cinder_rime.name: Cinder Rime
cinder_rime.description: Mark the creature you look at with frost; if it catches fire within 8 seconds, it explodes for 8 damage.

cleaving_hex.name: Cleaving Hex
cleaving_hex.description: Mark a target for 8 seconds; every hit on it also deals 3 damage to enemies within 3 blocks of it.

cloud_ascent.name: Cloud Ascent
cloud_ascent.description: Leap 8 blocks up and forward and gain slow falling for 6 s.

cloud_somersault.name: Cloud Somersault
cloud_somersault.description: Leap 10 blocks forward and gain Slow Falling for 5 seconds.

cold_meditation.name: Cold Meditation
cold_meditation.description: Meditate inside an ice block: invulnerable, and restores mana and stamina while inside.

collateral.name: Collateral
collateral.description: Mark a target for 15 seconds; if it dies it drops an extra loot roll and you gain Absorption II for 10 seconds.

conductive_mark.name: Conductive Mark
conductive_mark.description: Mark a target to glow 12 s; arrows hitting it chain lightning to 2 nearby enemies.

confession_brand.name: Confession Brand
confession_brand.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies, you gain strength I and allies within 8 blocks gain regeneration II for 6 s.

consecrated_ground.name: Consecrated Ground
consecrated_ground.description: Bless a 5-block area for 6 seconds, healing allies 1 heart per second and burning undead for 2 damage per second.

corona_halo.name: Corona Halo
corona_halo.description: For 10 seconds, a halo zaps the nearest enemy within 5 blocks every second for 3 damage and ignites it.

corpse_flower.name: Corpse Flower
corpse_flower.description: A huge rotting flower that spits poison at enemies and heals your summons near it.

corpse_hop.name: Corpse Hop
corpse_hop.description: Hop 3 times in quick succession; each landing deals 4 damage and Weakness to creatures within 2 blocks.

corrupted_grove.name: Corrupted Grove
corrupted_grove.description: Overgrowth of sculk and black roots that blind and root enemies.

coup_de_grace.name: Coup de Grace
coup_de_grace.description: Strike the creature you look at for triple damage if it is below 30% health.

crane_leap.name: Crane Leap
crane_leap.description: A leaping flip that lands with a thunderclap behind your target.

crimson_toll.name: Crimson Toll
crimson_toll.description: Strike the creature you look at, dealing all its remaining bleed damage at once and healing you that much.

crossbow_pavise.name: Pavise
crossbow_pavise.description: Plant a wooden shield for 15 s that blocks projectiles coming from the front.

crown_of_brine.name: Crown of Brine
crown_of_brine.description: For 15 s each kill raises a trident-wielding drowned ally for 20 s.

cursed_coin.name: Cursed Coin
cursed_coin.description: Throw a cursed coin; the creature hit gets slowness II and takes +20% damage for 8 s.

cursed_womb.name: Cursed Womb
cursed_womb.description: Summon 4 allied endermites for 12 seconds whose bites inflict Wither I.

cutpurse_stroke.name: Cutpurse Stroke
cutpurse_stroke.description: For 10 seconds, every creature you kill with a katana drops 1-3 emeralds.

dawn_bell.name: Dawn Bell
dawn_bell.description: Ring a bell that clears negative effects from allies within 6 blocks and makes enemies glow for 10 seconds.

dawnbreak.name: Dawnbreak
dawnbreak.description: Flash light in a 6-block ring, blinding enemies for 4 seconds and healing allies 3 hearts.

death_mark.name: Death Mark
death_mark.description: Mark an enemy; your melee hits on it deal bonus damage and refund stamina.

demon_mask.name: Demon Mask
demon_mask.description: For 10 seconds gain Strength II while enemies within 4 blocks have Weakness I.

desert_dates.name: Desert Dates
desert_dates.description: Conjure 4 dates that restore 3 hunger and grant fire resistance and speed I for 45 s.

divine_verdict.name: Divine Verdict
divine_verdict.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, lightning strikes the 3 nearest enemies.

drown.name: Drown
drown.description: A tidal grasp that silences the target and drowns it while it is held.

drowned_dead.name: Drowned Horde
drowned_dead.description: Raise a horde of five weak drowned around the creature you look at.

drowned_legion.name: Drowned Legion
drowned_legion.description: Summon three drowned that throw tridents.

drunken_sway.name: Drunken Sway
drunken_sway.description: For 8 seconds, each hit against you has a 50% chance to miss as you stagger 2 blocks aside.

duskward.name: Duskward
duskward.description: For 6 seconds, when hit you blink behind the attacker and gain Strength I for 3 seconds.

eldritch_arc.name: Eldritch Arc
eldritch_arc.description: Throw a cursed spark that chains to 3 enemies, applying Wither for 4 s.

ember_fists.name: Ember Fists
ember_fists.description: Your unarmed hits set enemies on fire for a while.

ember_garrote.name: Ember Garrote
ember_garrote.description: Strike the looked-at target within 4 blocks for bleeding and fire 6 s; double damage below 30% health.

ember_seed.name: Ember Seed
ember_seed.description: Throw a seed that sprouts a fire flower, burning enemies within 3 blocks for 4 seconds.

ember_skin.name: Emberskin
ember_skin.description: Burning skin: damage reduction, and melee attackers are set alight.

ember_tithe.name: Ember Tithe
ember_tithe.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies burning, it drops one extra loot roll and erupts in 3-block flames.

ent_stride.name: Ent Stride
ent_stride.description: Bark skin that also roots you in place: you cannot be knocked back and you regenerate.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.description: Coat your blade: hits poison the target for a while.

equinox_ring.name: Equinox Ring
equinox_ring.description: Release a ring that ignites creatures within 3 blocks and freezes those 3-6 blocks away for 4 seconds.

errant_charge.name: Errant Charge
errant_charge.description: Dash 8 blocks, dealing 6 damage and knockback to enemies you pass; damage is doubled while mounted.

exorcism.name: Exorcism
exorcism.description: Banish spirits around you: summons take heavy damage, and enemies lose their buffs and are soulburned.

fallen_angel.name: Fallen Angel
fallen_angel.description: A black-winged angel that drains enemies and heals you with it.

fallen_grace.name: Fallen Grace
fallen_grace.description: For 10 s each kill grants you Absorption I and heals allies within 5 blocks 2 HP.

fallen_retainer.name: Fallen Retainer
fallen_retainer.description: Summon an allied wither skeleton bodyguard for 20 seconds whose hits make enemies bleed.

fan_of_knives.name: Fan of Knives
fan_of_knives.description: Throw 5 knives in a 6-block cone, each dealing 3 damage and bleeding for 4 s.

faraday_cage.name: Faraday Cage
faraday_cage.description: Surround yourself with an iron bar cage for 8 seconds; enemies touching it are struck by lightning.

farshot.name: Farshot
farshot.description: Your next arrow deals double damage and bleeding for 6 s if it hits from over 20 blocks.

fault_line.name: Fault Line
fault_line.description: Send a ground shockwave 8 blocks ahead that launches enemies 3 blocks up and slows them for 4 seconds.

fence.name: Fence
fence.description: Summon a travelling trader for 60 s who buys common loot for emeralds.

firebrand_flask.name: Firebrand Flask
firebrand_flask.description: Throw a flask that bursts into flames, burning the ground in a 3-block radius for 4 seconds.

firecracker_purse.name: Firecracker Purse
firecracker_purse.description: Throw a pouch that bursts into 5 small fire blasts in 3 blocks, knocking enemies back and burning them 3 s.

flame_bulwark.name: Pyre Bulwark
flame_bulwark.description: Raise a wall of fire that also blocks enemy projectiles passing through it.

flame_rush.name: Flame Rush
flame_rush.description: A burning dash that you can chain up to three times.

flame_step.name: Flicker Flame
flame_step.description: Teleport in a burst of flame, leaving a patch of fire where you stood.

flaming_volley.name: Flaming Volley
flaming_volley.description: An arrow volley whose arrows set what they hit on fire.

flash_step.name: Flash Step
flash_step.description: A crackling teleport that always lands you behind the target you look at.

flensing_strike.name: Flensing Strike
flensing_strike.description: Strike the creature you look at, making it bleed and glow for 8 seconds.

flowing_counter.name: Flowing Counter
flowing_counter.description: For 8 seconds, after each dodge your next unarmed hit deals +6 damage and knocks back with a water burst.

forage.name: Forage
forage.description: Gather wild berries and herbs: food that cures poison and gives Regeneration.

fox_glamour.name: Fox Glamour
fox_glamour.description: Fade from sight; mobs ignore you until you attack.

foxfire.name: Foxfire
foxfire.description: Blue soul-fire orbs that circle you, then home in on enemies.

fracture_mark.name: Fracture Mark
fracture_mark.description: Mark a target for 10 s; each arrow hit removes 10% of its armour, up to 50%.

frost_angel.name: Frost Seraph
frost_angel.description: A guardian angel of ice that heals you and slows enemies near you.

frost_armor.name: Frost Armour
frost_armor.description: Icy skin: damage reduction, and melee attackers are slowed.

frost_charge.name: Glacial Charge
frost_charge.description: Launch forward on a trail of ice, freezing everything you pass through.

frost_trap.name: Frost Trap
frost_trap.description: A hidden trap that freezes the first enemy to step on it in an ice block.

frost_wolves.name: Winter Wolves
frost_wolves.description: Summon white wolves whose bites chill and slow.

frostfire_bolt.name: Frostfire Bolt
frostfire_bolt.description: A bolt of fire and ice: it burns and slows at the same time.

frozen_fingers.name: Frozen Fingers
frozen_fingers.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 2 s and stealing one of its positive effects.

frozen_sea.name: Frozen Sea
frozen_sea.description: A frost wave that freezes water into walkable ice wherever it passes.

funayurei.name: Funayurei
funayurei.description: Raise drowned ghosts with ladles that drag enemies down and slow them.

gaki_banquet.name: Gaki Banquet
gaki_banquet.description: Create a 5-block area for 5 seconds that drains 1 health per second from enemies into you and sets them soulburning.

galvanic_downpour.name: Galvanic Downpour
galvanic_downpour.description: A 6-block area rains for 6 s, dealing lightning damage each second, doubled against wet enemies.

gaunt_vessel.name: Gaunt Vessel
gaunt_vessel.description: Your bones snap one by one and your body tears into the Haunted Lord until you change back (Transform Back on the form's wheel): 25% faster, Night Vision and no fall damage; you strike with your claws (a three-hit chain, a raking leap attack in the air, a frenzied rush while sprinting) and can leap (hold to charge, cling to walls and ceilings), horrify, execute or change back. You cannot use weapons, items or other abilities, and cannot move while changing. Granted by the Haunted Locket.

geyser.name: Geyser
geyser.description: A water eruption under the target that launches it into the air.

ghouls_jerky.name: Ghoul's Jerky
ghouls_jerky.description: Conjure 3 jerky that restore 6 hunger, grant strength I for 20 s and remove hunger.

glacial_hex.name: Glacial Hex
glacial_hex.description: Mark a target with Weakness for 10 s; if it dies, frozen shards freeze enemies within 4 blocks for 4 s.

glacier_boulder.name: Glacier Boulder
glacier_boulder.description: Throw an ice boulder dealing 8 damage and Slowness III for 5 seconds to enemies within 2 blocks of impact.

glass_needle.name: Glass Needle
glass_needle.description: Throw a jade needle; the creature hit bleeds for 6 s and loses 20% armour.

glitter_bait.name: Glitter Bait
glitter_bait.description: Throw a shiny trinket that pulls mobs within 6 blocks toward it over 3 s.

goat_ram.name: Goat Ram
goat_ram.description: Summon 2 allied goats for 15 seconds that ram enemies, knocking them back 5 blocks.

golden_elixir.name: Golden Elixir
golden_elixir.description: Conjure 3 jade pills that heal 4 HP and grant resistance I for 15 s.

grapeshot_blast.name: Grapeshot Blast
grapeshot_blast.description: Fire a 6-block cone of scattershot dealing 6 damage and strong knockback.

grapple_arrow.name: Grapple Arrow
grapple_arrow.description: Fire an arrow with a rope; you are pulled to wherever it lands.

grave_fruit.name: Grave Fruit
grave_fruit.description: Conjure 3 grave fruits that restore 4 hunger, grant regeneration II for 6 s and cure poison.

grave_hex.name: Grave Hex
grave_hex.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, it explodes for 6 damage and wither I in 4 blocks.

grave_pact.name: Grave Pact
grave_pact.description: Mark a target; if it dies within 10 seconds you gain Absorption II for 10 seconds and an allied zombie bodyguard.

grave_pilgrim.name: Grave Pilgrim
grave_pilgrim.description: For 15 s, each kill heals you 3 and raises a skeleton that fights for you for 10 s.

grave_qi.name: Grave Qi
grave_qi.description: Mark the creature you look at; if it dies within 12 seconds, it rises as an allied husk for 20 seconds.

grave_rob.name: Grave Robbing
grave_rob.description: Dig up graves: digging soil or gravel has a chance to drop bones, gold or a skeleton that fights you.

gravity_snare.name: Gravity Snare
gravity_snare.description: Throw a void trap; the first creature to step on it levitates for 3 s and takes 4 void damage.

grog_ration.name: Grog Ration
grog_ration.description: Conjure 2 bottles of grog; drinking one grants Strength II and Resistance I for 30 seconds plus Nausea for 5 seconds.

guardian_angel.name: Summon Guardian Angel
guardian_angel.description: Summon an angel (a reskinned vex) that heals you and allies instead of attacking.

hailstorm.name: Hailstorm
hailstorm.description: A rain of hail that damages and slows everything beneath it.

hallowed_snowfall.name: Hallowed Snowfall
hallowed_snowfall.description: A 6-block area snows for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second with Resistance I and slowing undead.

hamstring_shot.name: Hamstring Shot
hamstring_shot.description: Fire an arrow that applies Slowness III and Bleeding for 5 seconds.

harbour_light.name: Harbour Light
harbour_light.description: Place a light pillar for 15 s giving allies within 8 blocks Night Vision and Regeneration I.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.description: Fire a harpoon from your crossbow that drags the target to you.

harrier.name: Harrier
harrier.description: For 10 s, each hit you land on a different enemy gives +5% speed (stacks 5 times).

harvest_swing.name: Harvest Swing
harvest_swing.description: Slash a 4-block cone, applying bleeding for 6 s and healing you 1 HP per enemy hit.

haunted_crockery.name: Haunted Crockery
haunted_crockery.description: Throw a spectral pot; the creature hit takes 4 damage and nausea for 5 s.

haunting.name: Haunting
haunting.description: Leave a ghostly copy of yourself that enemies attack; when it is struck it shrieks and makes them flee for 3 s.

headsmans_verdict.name: Headsman's Verdict
headsmans_verdict.description: Strike the creature you look at for triple damage if it is below 30% health, otherwise make it bleed for 4 seconds.

hearth_ward.name: Hearth Ward
hearth_ward.description: For 6 seconds a 4-block area grants allies Fire Resistance and Regeneration I and ignites enemies for 3 seconds.

heartwood_shelter.name: Heartwood Shelter
heartwood_shelter.description: Raise a small azalea dome for 10 s that gives Regeneration II to allies inside.

heat_mirage.name: Heat Mirage
heat_mirage.description: A heat shimmer: mobs lose track of you, and you take less fire damage while it lasts.

heavenly_facet.name: Heavenly Facet
heavenly_facet.description: Throw a jade prism that bursts in 4 blocks, healing allies 4 HP and giving enemies glowing and -20% armour for 6 s.

hikime_arrow.name: Hikime Arrow
hikime_arrow.description: Fire a whistling arrow that makes every creature within 8 blocks of impact glow for 10 seconds.

hired_muscle.name: Hired Muscle
hired_muscle.description: Summon a vindicator mercenary that fights for you for 30 s.

hit_and_run.name: Hit and Run
hit_and_run.description: For 10 seconds, melee hits grant Speed II and ranged hits grant Strength I, each for 2 seconds.

hoarfrost_tithe.name: Hoarfrost Tithe
hoarfrost_tithe.description: Drain 2 HP from every enemy within 5 blocks, slowing them 4 s and healing you per enemy hit.

hollow_aegis.name: Hollow Aegis
hollow_aegis.description: For 6 seconds, 50% of damage you take is redirected as magic damage to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks.

hollow_mask.name: Hollow Mask
hollow_mask.description: For 20 s undead and endermen ignore you and you have Night Vision.

holy_avenger.name: Avenging Wings
holy_avenger.description: Angel wings that also make every melee hit call down a small sunbeam on the target.

holy_hammer.name: Holy Hammer
holy_hammer.description: Throw a hammer that deals 7 damage, doubled against undead, and stuns the target for 1 second.

holy_shield.name: Aegis of Light
holy_shield.description: A shield of light that blocks projectiles and heals allies standing behind it.

holy_water.name: Holy Water
holy_water.description: A ball of blessed water that heals allies it splashes and burns undead.

honjin_ring.name: Honjin Ring
honjin_ring.description: Allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance I and Speed I for 8 seconds.

honor_guard.name: Honour Guard
honor_guard.description: Summon a spirit samurai with a tower shield that taunts enemies near you and takes hits for you.

hornet_swarm.name: Hornet Swarm
hornet_swarm.description: Summon 4 angry bees for 15 seconds whose stings apply Poison II.

hot_spring.name: Hot Spring
hot_spring.description: A steaming pool that heals allies in it and thaws freezing.

hundred_fists.name: Hundred Fists
hundred_fists.description: Rapidly punch the creature you look at 8 times over 2 seconds for 2 damage each.

hungry_ghost.name: Hungry Ghosts
hungry_ghost.description: For 15 s every kill releases a hungry ghost that flies at the nearest enemy and soulburns it; each kill extends the time.

hunter_trap.name: Bear Trap
hunter_trap.description: Place a hidden bear trap that roots and bleeds the first enemy to step on it.

hunting_hawk.name: Hunting Hawk
hunting_hawk.description: A hawk companion that circles you, marks the nearest enemy with Glowing and dives at it.

hurled_rimeaxe.name: Hurled Rimeaxe
hurled_rimeaxe.description: Throw a frozen axe that deals damage and freezes the creature hit for 3 seconds.

hyoga_draw.name: Hyoga Draw
hyoga_draw.description: Strike the creature you look at, freezing it for 4 seconds; already frozen targets take double damage.

iaido.name: Iaido Draw
iaido.description: A katana-only dashing draw cut; a parry in the 2 s before it doubles its damage.

ice_cocoon.name: Ice Cocoon
ice_cocoon.description: Encase yourself in ice blocks for 4 seconds, healing 2 health per second inside.

ice_dagger.name: Ice Dagger
ice_dagger.description: Throw a dagger of ice; it deals triple damage from behind and freezes.

ice_wall.name: Glacial Rampart
ice_wall.description: Raise a wall of ice instead of fire: it blocks movement and projectiles, then shatters into frost.

iceberg.name: Iceberg
iceberg.description: Drop a huge ice block onto the target from far above.

igloo.name: Igloo
igloo.description: Raise a snow shelter around you: allies inside are protected from cold and regenerate.

immolate.name: Immolate
immolate.description: A scorch that deals triple damage when it hits a target from behind.

immortal_peach.name: Peach of Immortality
immortal_peach.description: Conjure a peach that heals a lot and gives Regeneration and Resistance.

incense_circle.name: Incense Circle
incense_circle.description: Light a 5-block incense area for 6 s that grants allies regeneration I and saturation.

indulgence_coin.name: Indulgence Coin
indulgence_coin.description: Throw a gold coin; the creature hit gets weakness II for 6 s and you gain 4 absorption hearts.

infernal_sigil.name: Infernal Sigil
infernal_sigil.description: Mark the creature you look at for 8 seconds; each spell you cast deals 2 soul fire damage to it.

ink_bomb.name: Ink Bomb
ink_bomb.description: Throw an ink sac that blinds enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 4 s.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: Mark an ally for 10 s: 40% of the damage it takes is redirected to you.

iron_body.name: Iron Body
iron_body.description: Harden your body: large damage reduction and knockback immunity, but you move slower while it lasts.

iron_gut.name: Iron Gut
iron_gut.description: For 12 seconds, take 30% less damage and gain Strength I for 3 seconds whenever you are hit.

iron_quarrel.name: Iron Quarrel
iron_quarrel.description: Throw a heavy bolt that deals 8 damage, pierces up to 3 enemies and knocks each back 2 blocks.

iron_retort.name: Iron Retort
iron_retort.description: For 6 seconds, every melee hit you take deals 50% of its damage back to the attacker and knocks it back 3 blocks.

jade_barrage.name: Jade Barrage
jade_barrage.description: After the cast, a barrage of jade shards instead of soul skulls; each hit shatters armour.

jade_iai.name: Jade Iai
jade_iai.description: Dash 6 blocks forward, cutting every creature you pass and shattering 2 of their armour points for 8 seconds.

jade_lotus.name: Jade Lotus
jade_lotus.description: A jade lotus that heals allies and grants Symmetry resistance.

jade_nova.name: Jade Nova
jade_nova.description: A burst of jade shards around you instead of soul fire: symmetry damage that shatters armour.

jade_rampage.name: Jade Rampage
jade_rampage.description: Dash 6 blocks, shattering 3 armour from every enemy you pass for 8 seconds.

jade_rupture.name: Jade Rupture
jade_rupture.description: Strike the creature you look at, shattering its armour and dealing bonus damage equal to its armour value.

jade_serpent.name: Jade Serpent
jade_serpent.description: A jade serpent spirit that coils around the target and crushes it.

jade_skin.name: Jade Skin
jade_skin.description: Jade skin: damage reduction, and melee attackers take a little damage back.

javelin.name: Javelin Hurl
javelin.description: Throw your held spear; it pierces through the first target and flies back to your hand.

jiangshi_fists.name: Jiangshi Fists
jiangshi_fists.description: Become a jiangshi for a while: your unarmed hits drain health and you hop instead of walk.

kagami_frost.name: Kagami Frost
kagami_frost.description: For 8 s, half of melee damage you take is reflected and freezes the attacker 2 s.

kagu_flare.name: Kagu Flare
kagu_flare.description: Leap 5 blocks backward, leaving a 3-block trail of fire behind you.

kagura_bell.name: Kagura Bell
kagura_bell.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and giving undead slowness II.

kami_shrine.name: Kami Shrine
kami_shrine.description: Raise a small forest shrine: its kami heals allies near it and roots enemies that come close.

kami_swarm.name: Kami Swarm
kami_swarm.description: Summon 3 spirit bees for 20 s whose stings apply soulburn for 3 s.

kaminari_return.name: Kaminari Return
kaminari_return.description: Throw a lightning image of your blade up to 10 blocks; you teleport to where it lands and strike what is there.

kanabo_crush.name: Kanabo Crush
kanabo_crush.description: Strike the creature you look at for heavy damage, stunning it for 2 seconds.

kawarimi.name: Kawarimi
kawarimi.description: For 8 seconds, the next hit against you is negated and you blink 3 blocks behind the attacker with Invisibility for 3 seconds.

kesa_guard.name: Kesa Guard
kesa_guard.description: Strike the creature you look at within 4 blocks, then gain absorption equal to the damage dealt for 6 seconds.

kettle_bomb.name: Kettle Bomb
kettle_bomb.description: Throw a boiling kettle that bursts in 3 blocks, knocking creatures back 5 blocks and burning them for 3 seconds.

ki_slash.name: Ki Slash
ki_slash.description: Throw a ki crescent that travels 12 blocks, dealing 7 damage to every enemy it passes through.

ki_wave.name: Kamehameha Wave
ki_wave.description: A channelled beam of raw ki from both palms (Ray of Frost with blue spirit energy, no freezing).

kirisute_dash.name: Kirisute Dash
kirisute_dash.description: Dash 5 blocks, cutting every enemy you pass and making them bleed for 6 seconds.

kodama_wisps.name: Kodama Wisps
kodama_wisps.description: Summon 2 allays for 15 seconds that grant you Regeneration I every 3 seconds while near you.

koi_leap.name: Koi Leap
koi_leap.description: Dash 6 blocks forward and gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed I for 10 s.

kunai_rain.name: Kunai Rain
kunai_rain.description: In the air, throw a fan of five kunai where you look.

lasso_throw.name: Lasso Throw
lasso_throw.description: Throw a lasso that pulls the creature hit 6 blocks toward you and slows it for 3 s.

leaf_disguise.name: Leaf Disguise
leaf_disguise.description: For 10 s, mobs ignore you until you attack; that first attack stuns for 2 s.

leafen_hide.name: Leafen Hide
leafen_hide.description: Build a leaf-block hide around you; for 10 s you are invisible and deal +20% ranged damage.

leap_of_faith.name: Leap of Faith
leap_of_faith.description: Dive from a height and land on a target below with an assassination strike that takes no fall damage.

leviathan_hex.name: Leviathan Hex
leviathan_hex.description: Mark a target to take 1 drowning damage per second for 6 s; if it dies, you heal 4 HP.

lich_form.name: Lich Form
lich_form.description: Become a lich for a while: you cannot be healed but your spells cost health instead of mana and hit harder.

lightning_rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning_rod.description: Allies around you gain a shield and take no lightning damage while it lasts.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.description: Touch a locked chest or iron door to open it without the key.

long_road.name: Long Road
long_road.description: For 20 seconds, sprinting builds Speed up to III and your first hit after sprinting stuns for 1 second.

lookout_perch.name: Lookout Perch
lookout_perch.description: Raise a 4-block dirt pillar under you for 10 s; while on it you deal +30% ranged damage.

lotus.name: Lotus Bloom
lotus.description: A lotus opens beneath you, healing allies and cleansing one harmful effect from each.

lotus_arrows.name: Lotus Arrows
lotus_arrows.description: Fire 6 arrows in a ring around you, each applying Slowness II for 4 seconds.

lucky_penny.name: Lucky Penny
lucky_penny.description: For 15 s, each hit has a 15% chance to grant luck and 2 absorption hearts.

madness_ring.name: Madness Ring
madness_ring.description: Create a 4-block area for 5 seconds that deals 2 damage per second and applies Nausea and Blindness.

magpies.name: Magpie Flock
magpies.description: Magpies dive at enemies and knock the item out of a mob's hand.

malign_current.name: Malign Current
malign_current.description: For 10 s each kill releases a lightning burst hitting enemies within 3 blocks.

mangrove_thicket.name: Mangrove Thicket
mangrove_thicket.description: Raise a ring of mangrove roots around you for 8 s that blocks enemies.

mantra_of_mercy.name: Mantra of Mercy
mantra_of_mercy.description: For 12 seconds, each unarmed hit heals the lowest-health ally within 8 blocks for 2 health.

marked_for_the_block.name: Marked for the Block
marked_for_the_block.description: Mark a target for 10 seconds: it glows and takes 25% more damage; killing it resets this cooldown.

marrow_pilfer.name: Marrow Pilfer
marrow_pilfer.description: Strike the creature you look at, stealing one of its positive effects and 2 HP.

martyrs_zeal.name: Martyr's Zeal
martyrs_zeal.description: For 10 seconds, each hit you take heals allies within 6 blocks for 2 health and grants you Strength I.

mask_of_rule.name: Mask of Rule
mask_of_rule.description: Strike the creature you look at, shattering 30% of its armour for 8 s; your summons deal +30% damage to it.

mercy_wave.name: Mercy Wave
mercy_wave.description: A 6-block wave cone heals allies 4 HP and pushes enemies back 4 blocks.

mind_lift.name: Mind Lift
mind_lift.description: Lift every creature within 5 blocks with Levitation for 2 seconds, then slam them down for fall damage.

mind_splinter.name: Mind Splinter
mind_splinter.description: Strike the creature you look at, applying Nausea and Slowness and making it take 50% more damage for 6 seconds.

mirror_bolt.name: Mirror Bolt
mirror_bolt.description: Dash 6 blocks; a lightning echo at your start point strikes enemies within 3 blocks after 1 s.

mirror_bulwark.name: Mirror Bulwark
mirror_bulwark.description: For 6 seconds, projectiles that hit you deal no damage and their shooter takes that damage instead.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Images
mirror_image.description: Split into three short-lived copies that confuse enemies; only one is real.

mirrored_kata.name: Mirrored Kata
mirrored_kata.description: For 6 seconds, 50% of every melee hit you take is reflected back at the attacker.

mist_step.name: Mist Step
mist_step.description: Teleport in a burst of sea mist that blinds enemies around where you left.

monster_lore.name: Monster Lore
monster_lore.description: Look at a creature: it glows for 15 s and takes 15% more damage from you and your allies.

mossbound_circle.name: Mossbound Circle
mossbound_circle.description: A 5-block circle pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second, doubled on grass.

mountain_tea.name: Mountain Tea
mountain_tea.description: Conjure a flask of tea; drinking it grants Resistance I and Jump Boost II for 60 seconds.

mushin.name: Mushin
mushin.description: Focus that also makes any parry in the next 3 s count as a perfect parry.

necrotic_static.name: Necrotic Static
necrotic_static.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, dealing 2 damage to enemies and healing your summons.

net_throw.name: Net Throw
net_throw.description: Throw a net that pins and slows the first creature it hits.

nettle_shroud.name: Nettle Shroud
nettle_shroud.description: For 8 s, attackers get poison I for 4 s and being hurt makes you invisible for 2 s.

night_parade.name: Hyakki Yagyo
night_parade.description: A short night parade of yokai sweeps forward through your enemies, soulburning and weakening everything it passes.

night_watch.name: Night Watch
night_watch.description: Enemies within 8 blocks glow for 10 seconds and you become invisible for 4 seconds.

ninefold_ring.name: Ninefold Ring
ninefold_ring.description: A fire ring bursts 5 blocks around you, burning enemies 3 s; gain Resistance I 5 s per enemy hit, up to 3 stacks.

nomad_mount.name: Steppe Horse
nomad_mount.description: An armoured warhorse that is faster and can carry a rider into battle.

nomad_stew.name: Nomad Stew
nomad_stew.description: Conjure a hot stew; eating grants Absorption II and Speed I for 60 s.

numbing_venom.name: Numbing Venom
numbing_venom.description: For 10 s your hits freeze targets 2 s and poison them 3 s.

oath_of_shelter.name: Oath of Shelter
oath_of_shelter.description: For 8 seconds, half the damage allies within 6 blocks take is transferred to you instead.

obsidian_pact.name: Obsidian Pact
obsidian_pact.description: Raise a 5-wide, 3-tall crying obsidian wall in front of you for 10 seconds.

offal_feast.name: Offal Feast
offal_feast.description: Conjure raw offal that, when eaten, heals 6 hearts and grants Strength I for 20 seconds.

offering_onigiri.name: Offering Onigiri
offering_onigiri.description: Conjure 3 rice balls that restore 6 hunger and grant 2 absorption hearts and speed I for 60 s.

ofuda.name: Ofuda
ofuda.description: Throw a paper talisman that seals spirits: holy damage, double to the undead and to summons, and silences the target for 2 s.

oni_hearth.name: Oni Hearth
oni_hearth.description: A 5-block area pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and soulburning enemies inside.

oni_summon.name: Summon Oni
oni_summon.description: Summon a towering spirit oni with a kanabo instead of a samurai.

onibi.name: Onibi
onibi.description: Three ghost-fire wisps drift after enemies and burn them with soul fire that ignores fire resistance.

onigiri_offering.name: Onigiri Offering
onigiri_offering.description: Conjure a rice ball; eating grants Speed I and Haste II for 45 s.

onryo_seal.name: Onryo Seal
onryo_seal.description: Mark the creature you look at; if it dies within 10 seconds, its ghost bursts for 6 soul fire damage within 4 blocks.

ossuary_wall.name: Ossuary Wall
ossuary_wall.description: Raise a 5-wide bone block wall for 10 seconds; when it crumbles it releases 3 allied skeletons.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description: Gain Speed II and Haste II for 8 seconds; when it ends, discharge 8 damage to enemies within 4 blocks.

overgrowth_roots.name: Overgrowth Roots
overgrowth_roots.description: Entangle a 5-block area for 5 seconds, giving enemies Slowness V and 1 damage per second.

pack_mule.name: Pack Mule
pack_mule.description: Summon a spectral mule with a chest that follows you.

pale_pursuit.name: Pale Pursuit
pale_pursuit.description: For 6 s, each backstab applies wither II for 4 s and grants you speed II for 3 s.

palm_blood.name: Crimson Palm
palm_blood.description: A palm strike of blood that leeches a third of the damage, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_eldritch.name: Void Palm
palm_eldritch.description: A palm strike of void that pulls enemies in, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_holy.name: Radiant Palm
palm_holy.description: A palm strike of holy light that heals you for a quarter of the damage, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_ice.name: Frost Palm
palm_ice.description: A palm strike of ice that freezes, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_lightning.name: Thunder Palm
palm_lightning.description: A palm strike of lightning that stuns, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_nature.name: Thorn Fist
palm_nature.description: A palm strike of thorns that poison, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_soul.name: Soul Palm
palm_soul.description: A palm strike of soul fire that soulburns, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_spirit.name: Jade Palm
palm_spirit.description: A palm strike of jade that shatters armour, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

palm_water.name: Tide Palm
palm_water.description: A palm strike of water that knocks back hard, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.

pavise.name: Pavise
pavise.description: Raise a 3-wide, 2-tall oak plank wall in front of you for 10 seconds and gain Resistance I while within 3 blocks of it.

penitent_brand.name: Penitent Brand
penitent_brand.description: Mark the creature you look at; when it dies, you heal 6 health and allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration II for 5 seconds.

phantom_draw.name: Phantom Draw
phantom_draw.description: A dashing draw cut that leaves a phantom samurai behind, which repeats the cut a moment later.

phantom_drift.name: Phantom Drift
phantom_drift.description: Glide 5 blocks through enemies, freezing every creature you pass for 2 s.

phoenix_rebirth.name: Phoenix Rebirth
phoenix_rebirth.description: For 30 seconds, lethal damage instead revives you with 6 health and releases a 4-block fire ring.

phoenix_wings.name: Phoenix Wings
phoenix_wings.description: Wings of fire: fly, and enemies you fly over are set alight.

phylactery_ward.name: Phylactery Ward
phylactery_ward.description: For 10 s, the first lethal hit leaves you at 4 HP instead and summons 2 vexes for 15 s.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.description: Grip a creature and pull one item from its loot table out of it (once per creature).

pike_wall.name: Pike Wall
pike_wall.description: A row of spikes rises from the ground in front of you for 8 s; enemies touching them take 3 damage a second.

pinning_frost.name: Pinning Frost
pinning_frost.description: For 10 s your arrows freeze targets in place for 2 s.

pirate_crew.name: Pirate Crew
pirate_crew.description: Summon a crew of three drowned pirates with swords.

plasma_ball.name: Plasma Orb
plasma_ball.description: A ball of lightning that bursts into fire when it pops.

polar_flash.name: Polar Flash
polar_flash.description: A 6-block cone of auroral light deals lightning damage, blinds 2 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
powder_keg.description: Throw a powder keg that explodes after 1 second for 8 damage in 3 blocks without breaking blocks.

pressure_point.name: Pressure Point
pressure_point.description: Strike the creature you look at; if hit from behind, it is stunned for 3 seconds.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.description: Instead of a decoy goat, every mob nearby targets you and you gain Resistance I while it lasts.

pyre_quiver.name: Pyre Quiver
pyre_quiver.description: For 10 s your arrows ignite targets and deal +3 fire damage to targets already burning.

pyre_rage.name: Pyre Rage
pyre_rage.description: For 10 seconds, creatures you kill explode in a 3-block fire burst dealing 5 damage.

quake_slam.name: Seismic Slam
quake_slam.description: A heavier stomp that also roots enemies in place for 2 s.

quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
quickdraw.description: For 6 s, bows fire instantly at full charge and arrows deal +2 damage.

radiant_dagger.name: Radiant Dagger
radiant_dagger.description: Throw a dagger of light that burns undead and marks the target with Glowing.

raiders_feast.name: Raider's Feast
raiders_feast.description: Conjure 3 roasted mutton; eating one restores 6 health and grants Strength I for 45 seconds.

raijin_drums.name: Raijin's Drums
raijin_drums.description: Spirit drums beat overhead: each beat strikes an enemy near you with lightning, and the last one soulburns them all.

raiko_fracture.name: Raiko Fracture
raiko_fracture.description: Strike the looked-at target, shattering 5 armour; if its armour reaches 0, it is stunned 2 s.

rain_curtain.name: Rain Curtain
rain_curtain.description: Call rain on a 5-block area for 6 seconds, giving allies Regeneration I and enemies Slowness I.

rain_dance.name: Rain Dance
rain_dance.description: Create a 5-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Regeneration I and Dolphin's Grace and putting out fires.

rally.name: Rallying Banner
rally.description: Plant a banner that gives allies around it Resistance I and slow regeneration.

rattling_chains.name: Rattling Chains
rattling_chains.description: A 5-block area rattles for 5 s, giving enemies slowness III and glowing.

reanimate.name: Galvanise
reanimate.description: Raise the dead with lightning: they are fast and their hits spark.

reaper_mark.name: Reaper's Mark
reaper_mark.description: Mark an enemy; when it dies its soul is torn out and bursts, soulburning every enemy around it.

red_harvest.name: Red Harvest
red_harvest.description: For 10 seconds, each kill grants one more level of Strength, stacking up to Strength III.

restless_flock.name: Restless Flock
restless_flock.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies, it releases 3 vexes that fight for you for 15 s.

ribcage_trap.name: Ribcage Trap
ribcage_trap.description: Throw a bone that cages the creature hit in bone blocks for 4 s.

rift_hook.name: Rift Hook
rift_hook.description: Strike the creature you look at and pull every creature within 5 blocks of it toward it.

rift_hop.name: Rift Hop
rift_hop.description: Dash 8 blocks through creatures, dealing 4 void damage and blindness for 2 s to each one passed.

rift_tether.name: Rift Tether
rift_tether.description: For 8 s, your arrows teleport the creature hit 4 blocks toward you.

righteous_fervor.name: Righteous Fervor
righteous_fervor.description: For 8 seconds your melee hits heal you for 20% of the damage dealt and set undead on fire for 4 seconds.

rime_dome.name: Rime Dome
rime_dome.description: Encase yourself in a packed-ice shelter for 10 seconds, gaining Regeneration I while inside.

river_dragon.name: River Dragon
river_dragon.description: A jade river dragon instead of a sea serpent: it heals allies it passes.

road_onigiri.name: Road Onigiri
road_onigiri.description: Conjure 3 onigiri; eating one grants Speed I and Haste I for 60 seconds.

ronin_ancestors.name: Ronin Ancestors
ronin_ancestors.description: Summon 2 vexes as ancestral ronin for 20 seconds; their hits set targets soulburning.

rooftop_vault.name: Rooftop Vault
rooftop_vault.description: Kick the creature you look at back 3 blocks and launch yourself 5 blocks up and away.

rooted_trunk.name: Rooted Trunk
rooted_trunk.description: For 6 seconds, you cannot be knocked back and attackers are poisoned for 3 seconds.

rotroot_grasp.name: Rotroot Grasp
rotroot_grasp.description: Roots in a 6-block cone give enemies slowness V for 2 s and weakness I for 6 s.

ruyi_toss.name: Ruyi Toss
ruyi_toss.description: Hurl a spinning staff that pierces creatures in a 10-block line, damaging and knocking them back.

ryo_toss.name: Ryo Toss
ryo_toss.description: Throw a gold coin that stuns the creature hit for 2 seconds.

salt_circle.name: Salt Circle
salt_circle.description: A 4-block salt ring pulses for 6 s, dealing 3 damage per second to undead and clearing Weakness from allies.

samsara_turn.name: Samsara Turn
samsara_turn.description: For 10 seconds, each kill refills your dodge stamina and grants Resistance I for 5 seconds.

sanctified_icicle.name: Sanctified Icicle
sanctified_icicle.description: Throw a holy icicle that freezes the target 3 s and deals double damage to undead.

sanctify.name: Sacred Grove
sanctify.description: Holy grass grows around you; allies on it regenerate.

sanctuary_tent.name: Sanctuary Tent
sanctuary_tent.description: Build a 3x3 wool shelter around you for 10 s that grants regeneration I to anyone inside.

sandstorm_veil.name: Sandstorm Veil
sandstorm_veil.description: A 5-block sandstorm lasts 6 s, blinding enemies inside and making you invisible while in it.

sapjade_bark.name: Sapjade Bark
sapjade_bark.description: For 10 s, when hurt you heal 2 HP and the attacker loses 10% armour for 5 s.

scald.name: Scalding Steam
scald.description: A cone of steam that burns and blinds.

sculk_watcher.name: Summon Sculk Watcher
sculk_watcher.description: Summon a small sculk creature that blinds and sonic-pulses nearby enemies.

sea_legs.name: Sea Legs
sea_legs.description: For 20 s gain Dolphin's Grace, Water Breathing and immunity to knockback.

seafoam_vanish.name: Seafoam Vanish
seafoam_vanish.description: Become invisible with Speed II for 3 s; your first hit out of it deals +6 damage.

searing_sands.name: Searing Sands
searing_sands.description: Blast a 6-block cone of hot sand that blinds enemies 3 s and burns them 2 s.

seraph_embodiment.name: Seraph Embodiment
seraph_embodiment.description: Become a seraph of many eyes and wings for up to 30 s (cast again to leave): fly slowly, cast only spells, with 20% more spell power, faster mana regeneration and Regeneration. You cannot attack, use items or other abilities, and only your eye can be hit.

shackle_strike.name: Shackle Strike
shackle_strike.description: Strike the creature you look at, applying Slowness IV and Weakness I for 5 seconds and stealing one of its positive effects.

shadow_clone.name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
shadow_clone.description: Summon two clones of yourself that fight with your held weapon instead of casting spells.

shadow_guard.name: Shadow Guard
shadow_guard.description: A shield of shadow that, when it breaks, turns you invisible for 3 s.

shakedown.name: Shakedown
shakedown.description: Strike the creature you look at, knocking it back 4 blocks and making it drop its held item.

shatter_kick.name: Shatter Kick
shatter_kick.description: Kick the creature you look at 6 blocks back; if it is frozen, it shatters for double damage.

shatterguard.name: Shatterguard
shatterguard.description: For 8 seconds, enemies that hit you in melee are frozen for 3 seconds and given Slowness III.

shattering_current.name: Shattering Current
shattering_current.description: A 6-block water cone knocks enemies back and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

shatterstab.name: Shatterstab
shatterstab.description: Strike the looked-at target; if frozen, it takes triple damage and the freeze ends.

shepherds_toll.name: Shepherd's Toll
shepherds_toll.description: Ring a 6-block pulse that pulls enemies 3 blocks inward and applies soulburn for 4 s.

shide_strike.name: Shide Strike
shide_strike.description: Strike the creature you look at for 6 holy damage, doubled against undead, and apply soulburn for 4 s.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: With a shield in the off hand, slam it into the target in reach: stuns and knocks it back.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: For 6 s, allies standing behind you take 30% less damage from the front.

shieldbreaker_roar.name: Shieldbreaker Roar
shieldbreaker_roar.description: Roar in a 6-block cone, applying Weakness II and Slowness I to enemies for 6 seconds.

shimenawa_circle.name: Shimenawa Circle
shimenawa_circle.description: A 6-block ring soulburns enemies 4 s with Slowness I and gives allies Speed I for 6 s.

shiro_fracture.name: Shiro Fracture
shiro_fracture.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 3 s and shattering 4 armour for 8 s.

shock_purse.name: Shock Purse
shock_purse.description: Throw a coin pouch that stuns enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 2 s.

shura_mode.name: Shura Mode
shura_mode.description: For 8 seconds deal 40% more damage but take 20% more; each kill heals you 3 hearts.

shuriken_fan.name: Shuriken Fan
shuriken_fan.description: Throw 5 shuriken in a cone, each dealing damage and Bleeding for 4 seconds.

signal_flare.name: Signal Flare
signal_flare.description: Fire a flare; enemies within 6 blocks of impact glow for 10 s and burn for 3 s.

silent_shot.name: Silent Shot
silent_shot.description: A silent arrow; shot while sneaking or invisible it crits for half again as much.

silver_oil.name: Silver Oil
silver_oil.description: For 20 s your weapon deals +4 damage to undead and sets them on fire.

sirens_lure.name: Siren's Lure
sirens_lure.description: Pull enemies in an 8-block cone toward you and apply Weakness for 4 s.

skeleton_archers.name: Summon Skeleton Archers
skeleton_archers.description: Raise skeleton archers that shoot from range.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.description: A long thrust that hits every enemy in a 5-block line in front of you.

slag_hammer.name: Slag Hammer
slag_hammer.description: Strike the creature you look at, setting it on fire for 6 seconds and giving it Slowness III for 4 seconds.

sleight_palm.name: Sleight Palm
sleight_palm.description: Strike the creature you look at and steal one of its active potion effects.

slick_floor.name: Slick Floor
slick_floor.description: Coat the ground within 4 blocks in ice and gain Speed II for 5 s while enemies slip.

smite_bolt.name: Smiting Bolt
smite_bolt.description: A golden bolt from the heavens: double damage to undead.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: A burst of smoke that blinds everything in it and gives you a few seconds of invisibility.

smoulder_step.name: Smoulder Step
smoulder_step.description: Dash 6 blocks leaving burning ground; your next hit within 3 s ignites the target for 5 s.

snow_sentinels.name: Frost Sentinels
snow_sentinels.description: Summon snow golems whose snowballs slow and chill enemies.

snow_spirit.name: Yuki Spirit
snow_spirit.description: Summon small snow spirits that fly at enemies and freeze them.

snowblind_shot.name: Snowblind Shot
snowblind_shot.description: Throw a packed snowball that blinds the target 3 s and applies Slowness II 5 s.

snowfall_step.name: Snowfall Step
snowfall_step.description: Dash 6 blocks, leaving a line of powder snow behind you for 5 seconds.

snowshoe_bound.name: Snowshoe Bound
snowshoe_bound.description: Leap 8 blocks forward and gain Speed II for 10 s while on snow or ice.

solar_lance.name: Solar Lance
solar_lance.description: Throw a burning lance that deals 8 damage, doubled against undead, and ignites the target for 5 seconds.

soul_cleave.name: Soul Cleave
soul_cleave.description: An axe cleave that tears at the soul: soulburns everything hit and heals you for a little of the damage.

soul_fireball.name: Soulfire Orb
soul_fireball.description: A blue soul-fire fireball that ignores fire resistance.

soul_gorge.name: Soul Gorge
soul_gorge.description: For 10 seconds, each kill restores 2 hunger and 2 health.

soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul_harvest.description: A beam that pulls the soul out of an enemy: drains health and mana, and soulburns it.

soul_lantern.name: Soul Lantern
soul_lantern.description: A pale soul lantern drifts to the target and bursts in soul fire, applying soulburn.

soul_reaper.name: Soul Reaper
soul_reaper.description: A wide blood slash; each enemy it kills rises as a weakened skeleton that fights for you.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.description: A dash that strikes once with each hand; both hits soulburn and each target hit restores a little mana.

soulfire_kanabo.name: Soulfire Kanabo
soulfire_kanabo.description: Strike the creature you look at, soulburning it for 6 seconds; if it dies burning, enemies within 3 blocks catch soulburn.

soulflame_rift.name: Soulflame Rift
soulflame_rift.description: Open a 4-block rift for 5 s that pulls enemies toward its centre and applies soulburn.

spearfishers_focus.name: Spearfisher's Focus
spearfishers_focus.description: For 10 s hits on wet or swimming targets deal +50% damage and pull them 2 blocks closer.

spectral_boat.name: Spectral Boat
spectral_boat.description: Summon a ghostly boat that is faster than a normal one.

spider_brood.name: Spider Brood
spider_brood.description: Summon a brood of cave spiders whose bites poison.

spirit_aegis.name: Spirit Aegis
spirit_aegis.description: A shield of ancestral spirits that blocks projectiles; anything that strikes it is soulburned.

spirit_communion.name: Spirit Communion
spirit_communion.description: Sneak still to channel: spirits gather round you, restoring mana and stamina, and you keep 20% more spirit spell power for 20 s after.

spirit_hawk.name: Spirit Hawk
spirit_hawk.description: A ghost hawk that flies through walls, marks the nearest enemy with Glowing and soulburns it when it dives.

spirit_steed.name: Spirit Steed
spirit_steed.description: Summon a spectral horse that freezes a path over water as it runs.

spirit_step.name: Spirit Step
spirit_step.description: Teleport where you look, leaving a spirit double that taunts enemies and bursts.

spirit_tiger.name: Spirit Tiger
spirit_tiger.description: Summon a single white tiger spirit that fights beside you.

spirit_ward.name: Spirit Ward
spirit_ward.description: Ancestral spirits circle you and absorb damage; each hit they absorb burns the attacker with soulburn.

spirit_wolf.name: Spirit Wolf
spirit_wolf.description: Summon a single great spirit wolf that bites with soulburn.

stags_crown.name: Stag's Crown
stags_crown.description: For 12 s your melee hits knock enemies back 3 blocks and grant you Speed I for 3 s.

stance_blood.name: Stance: Crimson Form
stance_blood.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes deal 20% more and heal you for a tenth of it.

stance_eldritch.name: Stance: Void Form
stance_eldritch.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes weaken and pull the foe in.

stance_fire.name: Stance: Ember Form
stance_fire.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes set foes on fire.

stance_holy.name: Stance: Dawn Form
stance_holy.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes heal you a little and deal more to the undead.

stance_ice.name: Stance: Frost Form
stance_ice.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes slow and chill.

stance_lightning.name: Stance: Thunder Form
stance_lightning.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes stagger and arc a third of the damage to a nearby foe.

stance_nature.name: Stance: Bamboo Form
stance_nature.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes poison.

stance_soul.name: Stance: Soul Form
stance_soul.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes soulburn.

stance_spirit.name: Stance: Jade Form
stance_spirit.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes shatter armour.

stance_water.name: Stance: Flowing Form
stance_water.description: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes knock back and refund a little stamina.

static_bulwark.name: Static Bulwark
static_bulwark.description: For 8 seconds, each hit you take stuns the attacker for 1 second and arcs 4 damage to one nearby enemy.

static_edge.name: Static Edge
static_edge.description: For 10 s your hits from behind stun the target for 1.5 s.

static_kata.name: Static Kata
static_kata.description: For 10 seconds, every fifth unarmed hit stuns the target for 2 seconds.

static_snare.name: Static Snare
static_snare.description: A crackling snare that stuns the target and makes it drop what it holds.

steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
steady_aim.description: Crouch still for 2 s: your next bolt crits for +75% damage.

stealth_summons.name: Shadow Pack
stealth_summons.description: Summon two invisible shadow hounds that only show themselves when they bite.

still_mind.name: Still Mind
still_mind.description: Sneak still to channel: restores mana and stamina instead of other players' health.

stone_fist.name: Pilgrim's Palm
stone_fist.description: A plain, heavy palm strike that knocks the target back and breaks its guard.

stone_lotus_pose.name: Stone Lotus Pose
stone_lotus_pose.description: Root yourself for 6 seconds, gaining Resistance III and healing 1 heart per second.

storm_crows.name: Storm Crows
storm_crows.description: Crows wreathed in lightning dive at enemies.

storm_hounds.name: Storm Hounds
storm_hounds.description: Summon wolves wreathed in lightning whose bites chain a spark to a nearby enemy.

storm_jerky.name: Storm Jerky
storm_jerky.description: Conjure jerky; eating grants Speed II and Jump Boost II for 30 s.

storm_sea.name: Typhoon
storm_sea.description: A thunderstorm with heavy rain: lightning strikes wet enemies first and twice as hard.

storm_steed.name: Storm Steed
storm_steed.description: A horse of lightning that is very fast and shocks what it runs through.

stormsurge_leap.name: Stormsurge Leap
stormsurge_leap.description: Leap 10 blocks forward; on landing, lightning strikes enemies within 3 blocks.

strays.name: Summon Strays
strays.description: Raise frozen skeletons (strays) whose arrows slow.

styx_fog.name: Styx Fog
styx_fog.description: A 5-block fog lasts 6 s, giving enemies slowness II and your summons regeneration I.

sun_disk.name: Sun Disk
sun_disk.description: Throw a radiant disk dealing 7 damage that sets undead on fire and makes the target glow for 10 seconds.

sun_salutation.name: Sun Salutation
sun_salutation.description: Create a 4-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Fire Resistance and Strength I and igniting enemies.

sunbaked_flatbread.name: Sunbaked Flatbread
sunbaked_flatbread.description: Conjure flatbread; eating it grants Fire Resistance 60 s and Speed I 30 s.

sunrise_quiver.name: Sunrise Quiver
sunrise_quiver.description: Your next 3 arrows within 10 s make targets glow and deal +4 holy damage to undead.

sunspot.name: Sunspot
sunspot.description: Mark the creature you look at; after 3 seconds, a solar bolt strikes it for 10 fire damage.

superconductor.name: Superconductor
superconductor.description: Chain lightning that jumps twice as far between frozen targets and freezes them solid.

sweep_the_legs.name: Sweep the Legs
sweep_the_legs.description: Spin your spear: every enemy within 4 blocks is knocked down (stunned) for 1.5 s.

symmetry_slam.name: Symmetry Slam
symmetry_slam.description: Strike the creature you look at; the same damage is mirrored onto the nearest other enemy within 6 blocks.

taiga_bulwark.name: Taiga Bulwark
taiga_bulwark.description: Raise a 5-wide wall of packed snow and spruce leaves in front of you for 10 s.

taiji_seal.name: Taiji Seal
taiji_seal.description: A yin-yang seal on the ground: allies inside heal slowly, enemies inside take symmetry and spirit damage in turns.

tail_decoy.name: Tail Decoy
tail_decoy.description: Summon a fox decoy that draws mobs for 6 s, then bursts in jade shards removing 20% armour in 3 blocks.

taunting_shout.name: Taunting Shout
taunting_shout.description: Every enemy within 10 blocks is forced to attack you for 5 s.

temple_bell.name: Temple Bell
temple_bell.description: Ring a bell: enemies within 5 blocks are stunned for 2 seconds and pushed back 4 blocks.

terracotta.name: Jade Terracotta Guard
terracotta.description: Summon a jade terracotta soldier that guards you with a halberd.

tetsubo_sweep.name: Tetsubo Sweep
tetsubo_sweep.description: Swing in a 3-block ring, knocking all enemies back 4 blocks and giving them Slowness II for 4 seconds.

thermal_shock.name: Thermal Shock
thermal_shock.description: A fireball that explodes for double damage on a frozen or chilled target.

thieving_talon.name: Thieving Talon
thieving_talon.description: Strike the creature you look at with slowness II for 4 s and a 30% chance to drop one of its loot items.

thorn_volley.name: Thorn Volley
thorn_volley.description: A volley of thorns that poison and slow.

throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing_knives.description: Throw 3 knives in a fan, 4 damage each.

thrown_hatchet.name: Thrown Hatchet
thrown_hatchet.description: Throw an axe that deals 7 damage and makes the target bleed for 6 seconds.

thunder_charge.name: Thunder Charge
thunder_charge.description: Launch forward in a crackle of lightning, shocking everything you pass through.

thunder_gods_descent.name: Thunder God's Descent
thunder_gods_descent.description: Leap up and slam down where you look; lightning strikes every enemy within 4 blocks.

thunder_halo.name: Thunder Halo
thunder_halo.description: A 5-block thunder ring stuns enemies 2 s and heals allies 4 HP.

thunder_slam.name: Thunder Slam
thunder_slam.description: Stomp the ground; lightning strikes every enemy the shockwave hits.

thunder_step.name: Thunder Step
thunder_step.description: Teleport up to 14 blocks where you look in a flash of lightning; enemies near where you leave and where you land are shocked and staggered.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.description: A great storm phantom that circles overhead and calls lightning down on enemies near you.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.description: Clap a shockwave dealing 6 damage to enemies within 5 blocks, knocking them back and giving Nausea for 4 seconds.

thunderhide.name: Thunderhide
thunderhide.description: For 10 seconds, creatures that hit you in melee are zapped for 4 lightning damage.

thunderseed.name: Thunderseed
thunderseed.description: Throw a seed that sprouts and calls lightning on impact after 2 s, granting nearby allies Regeneration I.

tide_charge.name: Riptide Charge
tide_charge.description: Launch forward on a surge of water, sweeping enemies aside.

tide_guardians.name: Summon Tide Guardians
tide_guardians.description: Summon allied guardians (the ocean-monument fish) that beam your enemies.

tithe_strike.name: Tithe Strike
tithe_strike.description: For 8 s, each hit heals you 1 HP and has a 20% chance to drop a gold nugget.

tolling_bell.name: Tolling Bell
tolling_bell.description: A ghost-bell ring hits enemies within 6 blocks with Glowing and Slowness II for 5 s.

totem_ward.name: Warding Totem
totem_ward.description: A totem that heals allies in its circle instead of hurting enemies.

tracker_hound.name: Tracker Hound
tracker_hound.description: Summon a wolf for 30 s whose bites apply glowing and slowness I for 5 s.

tracker_s_instinct.name: Tracker's Instinct
tracker_s_instinct.description: Every illager, witch and pillager within 48 blocks glows for 20 s.

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.description: Every creature nearby glows and leaves a visible trail for a while.

trail_rations.name: Trail Rations
trail_rations.description: Conjure food for the whole party that also gives a short Regeneration.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.description: Gain speed II for 12 s; each kill during it restores 2 hunger.

treant.name: Summon Treant
treant.description: Summon a treant (a reskinned iron golem) that roots what it hits.

trident_rain.name: Trident Rain
trident_rain.description: A volley of tridents instead of arrows; they soak and slow.

tripwire.name: Tripwire
tripwire.description: Place an invisible tripwire trap: the first enemy to cross it is knocked down (stunned) for 2 s and slowed for 4 s.

trophy_strength.name: Trophy Strength
trophy_strength.description: Each undead or arthropod you killed in the last 60 s gives +2% damage (up to 20%) for 30 s.

tsuppari_barrage.name: Tsuppari Barrage
tsuppari_barrage.description: Hit the creature you look at with 5 palm strikes over 2 seconds, each pushing it back 1 block.

twin_fang.name: Twin Fang
twin_fang.description: A dash that strikes once with each hand, using both weapons' damage.

twin_reflection.name: Twin Reflection
twin_reflection.description: For 10 s, each arrow fires a mirrored twin at another target within 6 blocks.

twin_tails.name: Twin Tails
twin_tails.description: For 10 seconds, every hit you deal is copied onto the nearest other enemy within 5 blocks.

two_heavens.name: Two Heavens
two_heavens.description: For 10 seconds, each melee hit strikes twice, the second strike dealing 50% damage.

umbral_knot.name: Umbral Knot
umbral_knot.description: Throw a void orb; teleport behind the first creature it hits and give it weakness II for 5 s.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.description: Pull every creature within 6 blocks toward you, then deal 5 damage to those within 2 blocks.

undertow_anchor.name: Undertow Anchor
undertow_anchor.description: Mark a target for 6 seconds: it has Slowness II and is pulled 1 block toward you every second.

undertow_frost.name: Undertow Frost
undertow_frost.description: Pull all enemies within 6 blocks toward you and freeze them for 3 s.

underworld_gate.name: Underworld Gate
underworld_gate.description: Open the Malevolent Shrine domain: everything within 12 blocks is rooted for 10 s (and can still be executed) and you turn invisible for 10 s.

usury_pact.name: Usury Pact
usury_pact.description: For 10 s, each kill drops an extra emerald and refunds 20% of your mana.

vampire_bite.name: Vampire Bite
vampire_bite.description: A bite from behind that drains three times as much health.

vapour_dash.name: Vapour Dash
vapour_dash.description: Dash 7 blocks on a jet of steam, setting creatures you pass on fire for 4 seconds.

veiled_step.name: Veiled Step
veiled_step.description: Dash 5 blocks and gain Invisibility for 4 seconds; your next unarmed hit in that time deals +8 damage.

vermilion_shard.name: Vermilion Shard
vermilion_shard.description: Throw a burning jade shard that sets the target on fire for 4 s and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

vine_lash.name: Vine Lash
